incidents: Copied CIC-GOVERNANCE suites entered Sigil's broad Node test discovery and expected foreign files, dependencies, and commit history.
process_learnings: When copying shared runtime packages into another repository, keep that repository's test discovery explicit and retain all owned test locations.
Use a failing foreign suite in a disposable fixture to prove discovery exclusion, and an owned failing suite to prove the gate still blocks.
Remove NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from nested Node test-runner fixtures so inherited runner state cannot suppress their execution.
Verify the actual multi-repository workflow after pushing; a local fixture pass alone does not prove live matrix behavior.
